description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tualete, ne Astir perballe Vila L2 kompleksi Fratari.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e gjashte te parafundit te nje pallati te miradministruar me ashensor.
Ka nje sipërfaqe prej 100 m2 bruto dhe 88 m2 neto. 
Cmimi 140,000 euro
description_en: 2+1+2 bathroom apartment for sale, in Astir, in front of Vila L2, Fratari complex. The apartment is located on the penultimate sixth floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. It has an area of ​​100 m2 gross and 88 m2 net. The price is 140,000 euros
